name: Ankum (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and white in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ankum (a red saltire between yellow rings on white).
history: The hoisted flag is divided twice into white, red and white with the arms at the centre, as described in the municipal charter.

features.role: Ankum arms — red saltire and rings on white
